name: Objective 06 seeded queries
status: FROZEN, 9 November 2026 (D-110). Approved by the lead on 8 November; the eight genuinely unanswerable asks were then replaced by wordings screened on retrieval scores alone, by the lead's decision of 9 November. Never tuned against again (D-93). An unscreened re-run of this set is the acceptance test for any future fix to FR-12's declines.
corpus: corpus/objective-02: the 25 valid items of the 1 November snapshot
notes: `via` is `ask` (POST /api/ask, a one-off question) or `search` (GET /api/search, keyword).

`expected_in_log` is the objective's expectation after one aggregation cycle. `subject` groups the unanswerable queries that must aggregate into one entry; its expected occurrence count is the number of queries sharing it.

Permission-only queries are asked by the Employee about items only an Administrator can read: D09, D16, T02 and T05. A09 is the control: the same keyword search as P03, by an Administrator, finds results.
None of these wordings appears in questions.json, threads.json, dev-set.json or dev-set-v2.json.

screened_top_score is the highest cosine score of any passage the asking role may read, measured by scripts/citation_harness.py --scores-only on kmp_obj0506_20261101 at commit fb9e18a with FLM v0.9.39 (runs/2026-11-09/screening*/). Every unanswerable ask is at or under 0.25, so it takes no-answer path A on the shipped build (RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD 0.30); every answerable ask clears 0.30 with its expected source ranked first.

The screening is a verification choice, not a fix. FR-12's decline weakness stays an open finding (D-102's 8 November note): the first wordings of the same subjects were mostly answered from readable material (runs/2026-11-08/pre-measurement/).
